blocks.text: Rockwell Ryan Ripperger, vocalist of American pop-rock band Stephen Speaks, has fulfilled his dream of meeting boxing legend Manny Pacquiao, even getting the chance to perform for the Filipino sports icon. Ripperger shared photos of himself with Pacquiao in a Facebook post on Monday, Nov. 16, revealing that he had been invited to the boxing champion’s house in the Philippines to sing for him. “I wanted to meet Manny Pacquiao and got invited to his house to sing for him.
